content: Yesuusi Ooratha Qaalaa Caaquwaa Qeesatuwaa Ubbatuwaa Kaappuwaa
Nuuni haasayiyaa wolqqaamabay hawaa; saluwan Ubbaappe Bolla Xoossay uttiyaa kawutethaa oydiyaappe ushechcha bagganna utteedda qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuu, hawaa malay nuussi de7ee.
Geeshsha Sa7aaninne tumu Dunkkaaniyan I oothee; he Dunkkaanii asay esseeddawaa gidennaan, Xoossay esseedawaa.
Qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuu ubbay imuwaanne yarshshuwaa Xoossaw immanaw sunthetteedda diraw, ha qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappookka yarshshanaw ittibay de7anaw koshshee.
Simmi sa7an I de7iyaawaa gidooppe, ubbakka qeesa gidenna; ayissi gooppe, higgii azaziyaawaadan, imuwaa immiya qeesatuu de7iino.

Unttunttu qeesatuwaadan oothiyaa kiitay saluwan de7iyaa oosoo tumu leemisuwanne eeshuwaa; ayissi gooppe, Muse Dunkkaaniyaa essana hanishshin, Xoossay A, “Akeeka; ubbabaakka taani neena deriyaa huuphiyaan besseedda leemisuwaa kaallaade ootha” yaageedda.
Shin Yesuusi gaannatiyaa caaquu kasewaappe aadhdhiyaawaadankka, aw imetteedda oosuukka unttunttuwappe aadhdhee; ayissi gooppe, he caaquu Xoossay immana geedda ubbaappe aadhdhiyaa kiitaan oosetteedda.
Ayissi gooppe, koyro caaquwaan balay baynnawaa gidintto, laa7entho caaquwaa koshshenna.
Shin unttuntta boriidde, Goday hawaadan yaagee;

content.text: unttunttu aawatuwaa kushiyaa oyiqqaade, goochcha kesseedda wode,
taani Israa7eeliyaa asaanna caaqettana caaquu hawaa:
Taani ta higgiyaa unttunttu qofaan wothana;
Taani unttunttu Xoossaa gidana; unttunttukka ta asaa gidana.
Ayissi gooppe, unttunttu naa7aappe cimaa gakkanaw ubbay taana eriino.

content: Xoossay ooratha caaquwaa giide haasayiyaawan koyrowaa eciseedda; qassi eciyaabayinne wuriyaabay ellekka dhayana.
